text: Astronomy defines itself as the scientific examination of celestial objects and phenomena. A main area of investigation involves tracking how various bodies move within orbits that populate our solar system. The Earth travels around the Sun in an ellipse that is nearly perfect, representing a primary feature. Geologists also examine craters found on Mars and the Moon alongside other surface marks to extract information about geological composition and dynamic activity. Analyzing these characteristics allows researchers to comprehend how the solar system formed and evolved over time, which may offer insights into the development of planets beyond our own.
